description: This file provides an API for managing system services using procd, including functions to open/close services and instances, set parameters, check status, kill services, send signals, and handle triggers and configuration validation. It also includes functions for mDNS service advertisement and integration with ubus and uci.

methods.name: procd_open_service
methods.description: Initializes a new service message with optional script.

methods.name: procd_open_instance
methods.description: Adds an instance to the current service.

methods.name: procd_set_param
methods.description: Sets parameters for a service or instance based on type.

methods.name: procd_running
methods.description: Checks if a service/instance is running.

methods.name: procd_kill
methods.description: Kills a service or all instances.

methods.name: procd_send_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to a service/instance.

methods.name: procd_status
methods.description: Gets the current status of a service/instance.

methods.name: procd_open_data
methods.description: Opens a data object for a service.

methods.name: procd_set_config_changed
methods.description: Notifies that configuration has changed for a package.

methods.name: uci_load_validate
methods.description: Validates a UCI section and optionally calls a callback.
